description_en: Copies an image to another region. To share an image across regions, call this operation to copy the image to the destination region first, and then share it
description_zh: 将镜像复制到另一地域。如需跨地域分享镜像，可以先调用本接口将镜像复制到新地域再进行分享
kebab_example: aliyun ecd copy-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-gx2x1dhsmusr20000 --destination-image-name Office_Shanghai --destination-region-id cn-shenzhen --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyImage

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image to be copied
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the new image created by the copy operation. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 复制出来的新镜像的名称。长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: destination_image_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the image in the destination region. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 复制镜像目标地域的描述。长度为2\~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: destination_description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination region to which the image is copied. The destination region ID must be different from the current region ID of the image. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 复制镜像目标地域的ID，必须与镜像的当前地域ID不同。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: destination_region_id

ImageId.description_en: The image ID in the destination region
